ننكمش (form VII)
# نَنْكَمِشُ (nankamišu) /nan.ka.mi.ʃu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
# نَنْكَمِشَ (nankamiša) /nan.ka.mi.ʃa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
# نَنْكَمِشْ (nankamiš) /nan.ka.miʃ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْكَمَشَ (inkamaša)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
